name: Quant Fun
longDescription:
QuantFun is a platform for building, testing, and deploying trading strategies across multiple venues, including Lighter, Hyperliquid, Polymarket, and more.
At its core is a strategy studio with high-quality building blocks, a powerful backtesting engine, and robust infrastructure built for fast execution. QuantFun brings the entire workflow into one place, helping users turn trading ideas into live strategies - from initial design and testing to deployment
